openai.reasoning: They commit to pressing blue and argue for cooperation/collective optimality, but they do not identify the dominant-strategy logic (red is individually safer regardless of others) and instead treat blue as potentially rational depending on beliefs about others; they also correctly state the basic mechanics (blue majority saves everyone, red majority saves only red-pressers).
